Configure current feature

  1. Author eligible Rillmere sites:12ore and24tree candidates, quotas4/8, spacing800cm, road exclusion250cm, slope limit30degrees as test proposals. Store reproducible zone seed/generation.
  2. Place BP_ResourceDirector once and BP_ResourceNode projections only at validated candidate transforms. Assign mining/wood tools and profession records; add gathering progress UI.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. Restart the disposable zone with a recorded seed and candidate-set revision; inspect selected site IDs. Reject one road/steep/blocked candidate.
  2. A and B start mining the same active ore generation. At commit, exactly one claim wins:2ore and5miningXP once; loser receives NodeDepleted.
  3. A chops a valid biome tree: tool check,4second server progress,3logs/5woodXP, depletion, proposed180second respawn.
  4. Disconnect/cancel and restart around both progress and committed-depletion boundaries.
Expected success
No reward comes from client timer/notify; node generation claim and material/professionXP commit are atomic.
Depletion replicates to both clients. Durable respawn generation policy recreates only eligible unclaimed nodes without duplicating rewards.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. Herbalism is optional infrastructure reuse; no supplied3Dore/tree meshes or biome ecosystems are claimed.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. From phase03 onward run two separate clients; disconnect A while B remains, then reconnect with the correct identity.
  4. From phase05 onward query committed receipt/revision after timeout/restart. From06 onward reject old source epoch after transfer.

Stop condition and deferred work

Two players contest the same node and exactly one depleted-generation grant succeeds.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
